items.description: INDIAN NATIONAL CONGRESS GROUP, BOMBAY, DECEMBER 1904. Front Row. From left to right. Dinshaw Edulji Wacha (ex-President). Sir William Wedderburn. Bart. (ex-President). F..J. Lalji, H A. Wadia. N M. Sa
